about_item: IDEAL SIZE FOR SMALL TO MEDIUM DOGS: With a 7.5-inch diameter and 1.3-inch height, this feeding mat is perfect for your little ones. It reduces your dog's stress and anxiety by encouraging soothing licking activities. Less stress means more tail wags!

EXTEND MEAL TIME BY 10X: Our clever maze design turns your pet’s every meal into an exciting adventure, dramatically extending their eating time to support healthy digestion. Slow down their fast eating and make mealtime a fun and engaging challenge!

DIET DIVERSITY: Yogurt, peanut butter, kibble—oh my! This bowl handles it all, encouraging your dog to enjoy a varied and nutritious diet. Plus, it's microwave and freezer-safe, so you can heat or freeze meals to let your pet enjoy different food textures.

FOOD-GRADE SILICONE: Made from durable, non-toxic silicone, this bowl ensures your pet's health and safety. With its strong suction cup base, it stays securely in place, preventing messy spills and making mealtime hassle-free. A must-have for your pup's daily supplies!

Easy to Clean: Less maintenance means more fun with your furball friend! Our slow feeder is dishwasher-safe for quick and easy cleaning. Just rinse or pop it in the dishwasher to keep it spotless, ensuring more joyful moments.

summary.text: Customers find the slow feeder bowl effective at slowing down eating, with one mentioning it works particularly well for ravenous Yorkies. The bowl receives positive feedback for its amazing quality, easy cleaning, and strong suction that keeps it firmly in place. They appreciate its good size, particularly for larger kibble, and find it visually appealing, with one describing it as a cute slow feeding bowl. Customers disagree on the depth of the grooves.
